aesthetic_vibe: Apple meets Tesla and Nothing. Minimal, futuristic, high-performance, visually immersive, raw tech elegance.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A: The Tetris Grid) for marketing and feature showcases. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/5, 1px border-white/10. Used for sticky nav, product cards, and feature blocks.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis. Parallax background layers.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1), borders illuminate with neon green glow, images scale up by 1.05.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and scale up via framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons have magnetic pull effect or glowing trace border.

buttons.primary: Solid neon green background (#00FF66), black text, bold, slight glow shadow.
buttons.secondary: Glassmorphism base, white text, 1px white/10 border. Hover state border turns neon green.

cards.product: Glass container, high-quality image, subtle gradient overlay from bottom, mono specs text.

navigation.header: Fixed top, Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40), minimal links, primary CTA. Dark text logo.
navigation.footer: Massive padding, large typography for brand impact, gold emblem logo.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='hero-shop-button').

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Light weight for tech feel)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Outfit (headings) and Manrope (body) from Google Fonts.
Implement the animated loading screen using the Gold Emblem logo scaling up with a neon green glow.
Hero section must use the floating_earbuds image with an anti-gravity framer-motion floating animation. The eco_particles_bg should be the background with a parallax effect.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for bento grids and asymmetric layouts instead of Shadcn standard cards.
For the Coming Soon section, use the smart_glasses image.
For the Sustainability (V Green) section, use the eco_packaging image.
Implement custom scrollbars (dark track, green thumb).
Never use generic white backgrounds. Everything must be Obsidian Black or Tinted Glass.
Ensure the navbar is sticky with backdrop-blur and uses the dark_text logo.
